title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
summary: Change at most k letters to make the longest possible run of one repeated letter.

tests.explain: Replace the C with a B: "BBBBB" (indices 1 to 5) has length 5.
The whole string is already one letter.
With no replacements allowed, the best is a single letter.

hints: For a fixed substring, which letter should you keep, and how many replacements does that cost?
Keep the most frequent letter. The cost is the window length minus that letter's count; the window is valid when the cost is at most k.
Slide a window with letter counts. Extend right; while the cost exceeds k, move left forward. Record the window length after each step.

complexity.time: O(n): each index enters and leaves the window once (with a 26-letter scan per check, O(26 · n))
